headings.usage: H1 maxes at text-6xl. Use for section titles. Left-aligned default.

labels_eyebrows.usage: Above headings, tags, status indicators, and stats.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace standard drop shadows with radial CSS glows (e.g., box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(37,99,235,0.1)).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders on all cards (border-white/10). No soft muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the base background to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with border-b border-white/10.

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10
navigation.content: Logo (left), Links (center), Sign In & Sign Up (right). Nav MUST be visible on desktop.

hero.structure: Asymmetrical. Left: Massive Display H1 (text-5xl md:text-6xl+ tracking-tight), Mono eyebrow, paragraph, Primary & Secondary CTAs. Right: Abstract visual or glowing dashboard mock.
hero.ctas: Primary: Sign Up (Electric Blue bg). Secondary: Sign In (Ghost/Outline). Route both paths explicitly to /login.

how_it_works.structure: Bento Grid (Mode A: Tetris). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
how_it_works.items: Cards with varying spans (e.g., col-span-8, col-span-4). Show the flow: AI Conversation -> Lead Scoring -> Appointment.

features.cards: Use 'Tracing Beam' style borders or subtle hover glows. 4px radius.

social_proof.content: Stats (e.g., '$50M+ Inventory Matched') + Dealership partner names in font-mono-plex. Very slow drift.

value_section.structure: Asymmetrical split. Image on right (car showroom dusk), bold high-contrast text left. Spacing: py-32.

footer.structure: Large 'Ready to acquire?' CTA at top. Standard links and 'Sign In' link bottom.

motion.hover: Crisp and fast. Buttons: hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.4)]. Cards: hover:border-white/20 transition-colors duration-200.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Use framer-motion if available, else CSS keyframes.

button.primary: bg-[#2563EB] text-white hover:bg-[#1D4ED8] font-medium px-6 py-3
button.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5 px-6 py-3
button.rules: Must include data-testid. DO NOT center buttons inside text blocks randomly.

card.rules: Never center text inside feature cards. Left-align for optical clarity.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract blue data technology (circuit/nodes). Use with bg-black/50 overlay.

value_dealership.description: Modern car showroom at dusk. Use to anchor the 'For Dealerships' section.

dashboard_context.description: Car dashboard illuminated at dusk. High-end automotive feel.

media.rules: Ensure maximum height 80vh on mobile. Use subtle 1px borders on images. Apply dark overlays (bg-black/30) if placing text over images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients or glows meets 4.5:1 ratio. Provide explicitly lighter hover states.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-signup-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Assemble a complete SaaS landing page in your main App file or components.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical alignments, grids, and precise spacing.
Route BOTH 'Sign Up' and 'Sign In' actions to the /login flow.
Use standard Tailwind classes mapped to Shadcn tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, border-border).
Inject the provided Unsplash images into the exact sections defined.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on the nav; use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent base color.
Include a 'How it works' bento grid with specific dealership/AI copy (Lead Scoring, Inventory Match).
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' look. Use the mono font for eyebrows, small radius (rounded-sm), and crisp 1px borders.
Make sure every button, link, and input has a data-testid.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use lucide-react for icons. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
